from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityCountRecord(BaseModel):
    """An equity count record from one company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in this filing")
    count_value: int | None = Field(description="The numerical count of shares/units outstanding")
    equity_type: str | None = Field(description="What is counted: 'shares', 'units', etc.")
    count_label: str | None = Field(description="How the document labels this metric, e.g., 'shares issued and outstanding', 'units of beneficial interest'")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which this count is reported")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text showing the count and its label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_counts: list[EquityCountRecord]
